Dear CXG Team,

I am excited to apply for the Freelance Luxury Brand Evaluator position. As a customer who appreciates the craftsmanship and service of premium and luxury brands, I am drawn to the opportunity to provide feedback that can influence brand strategies and elevate the customer experience.

My professional background has equipped me with a keen eye for detail and a structured approach to observation. In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I conduct technical SEO audits, analyze performance data, and optimize content for search engines. This work requires meticulous attention to detail and the ability to identify areas for improvement—skills that are directly transferable to evaluating luxury brand experiences.

I am also the creator of mirook.com, a website for a Belgian youth chess champion, where I implemented structured data and performed iterative audits to improve visibility. This project demonstrates my ability to work independently, manage multiple tasks, and deliver high-quality results.

I am observant, reliable, and passionate about customer experience. I understand the importance of providing honest, objective feedback, and I am committed to complying with all project objectives and special requirements. I am comfortable using mobile applications and completing questionnaires efficiently.

I have already registered on live.cxg.com and am ready to complete the certification process. I am available for assignments in-store, online, or both, and I am eager to contribute to the luxury market.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to work with CXG and help shape the future of luxury brand experiences.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Observation & feedback: detail-oriented, objective, reliable, punctual
- Customer experience: passionate about premium and luxury brands, existing customer
- Digital tools: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads

- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
